note: Model aliases reflect Qwen Code / DashScope ecosystem. Update ONLY model_aliases when models change. Routing logic never changes.

tasks.label: Security audit / SAST
tasks.description: SAST audit against OWASP Top 10, crypto review, auth, JWT, injection, XSS, CSRF.
tasks.instructions: Act as SAST auditor. Analyze code against OWASP Top 10. Deliver severity report (critical/high/medium/low), locate the vulnerable fragment, and provide corrected code.

tasks.label: Frontend & creative UI
tasks.description: Web components, GSAP/Three.js animations, Tailwind, React, responsive and accessible.
tasks.instructions: Create modular, accessible (a11y), responsive components. Use current framework standard syntax. No inline CSS unless strictly necessary.

tasks.label: Backend / RESTful APIs
tasks.description: API design and implementation, microservices, authentication, endpoints, FastAPI/Django/Express.
tasks.instructions: Design API with clear contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger). Implement input validation, structured error handling, secure authentication, and per-endpoint documentation.

tasks.label: DevOps / Infrastructure / IaC
tasks.description: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, pipelines, cloud AWS/Azure/GCP.
tasks.instructions: Generate idempotent Infrastructure as Code. Include state management, locks, and rollback. Prioritize reproducibility: same code must produce same environment.

tasks.label: Data science / Analytics
tasks.description: Data analysis, pandas, numpy, statistics, machine learning, visualization, reports.
tasks.instructions: Perform analysis step by step: cleaning, exploration, modeling, and actionable conclusions. Document decisions and show code for each stage.

tasks.label: System architecture
tasks.description: Architecture design, scalability, diagrams, technical decisions, patterns.
tasks.instructions: Act as senior software architect. Analyze trade-offs, present 2-3 options with pros/cons, recommend one and justify. Include ASCII or Mermaid diagrams.

tasks.label: Documentation / Writing
tasks.description: Technical docs, README, guides, tutorials, comments, manuals.
tasks.instructions: Write clear, structured documentation with real usage examples. Prioritize clarity over length. Use hierarchical headings and code blocks.

tasks.label: Quick fix / maintenance
tasks.description: Simple bugs, typos, log errors, minimal patches, quick adjustments.
tasks.instructions: Solve the problem directly with the minimum necessary patch. Do not refactor adjacent code or change unrelated behavior.

tasks.label: Testing / QA / Quality
tasks.description: Unit, integration, e2e tests, coverage, TDD, quality CI.
tasks.instructions: Write meaningful tests that validate behavior, not implementation. Cover edge cases and errors. Run the suite and report coverage.

tasks.label: Database / Data modeling
tasks.description: Data modeling, SQL, migrations, query optimization, indexes.
tasks.instructions: Model data with referential integrity. Optimize queries with proper indexes. Include versioned migrations and explain schema reasoning.

tasks.label: Mobile applications
tasks.description: Android/iOS apps, React Native, Flutter, Kotlin, Swift.
tasks.instructions: Generate mobile code following platform guidelines (Material/HIG). Consider performance, memory, and offline states. Include permission handling.

tasks.label: Migration / Refactoring
tasks.description: Legacy code refactor, framework migration, technical debt, quality improvement.
tasks.instructions: Refactor in small, verifiable steps. Preserve external behavior. Prioritize by risk and value. Document what changed and why.

tasks.label: CLI / Automation / Scripts
tasks.description: Shell scripts, PowerShell, automation, cron jobs, batch tasks.
tasks.instructions: Write robust scripts with error handling, clear output, and help flags. Cross-platform compatible when possible. No unnecessary external modules.

tasks.label: Game development
tasks.description: 2D/3D games, Godot, Unity, Three.js, physics, gameplay.
tasks.instructions: Develop with a clear game loop. Keep logic separated from rendering. Optimize performance for target framerate.

tasks.label: Research / Technical analysis
tasks.description: Market research, comparisons, state of the art, external code analysis.
tasks.instructions: Research thoroughly and deliver structured report: executive summary, key findings, comparison if applicable, and final recommendation with justification.
